caption:
His glass first, then hers

The jug came to the table, and she filled his glass before her own.

Filling theirs first costs nothing, and the person across the table notices who thinks of them.

For whoever fills your glass before their own.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a glass jug of water in the middle and two empty glasses, one on each side. A ink-black block figure with white eyes on the left leans in and the glass nearest the royal blue block figure on the right fills first. The blue one opens its eyes wide and turns happy. Then the black one's own glass fills and its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me pouring water at dinner, to: poured theirs first. then mine.
